definition.clearance_m: distance to first solid at eye height (pos.y + 1.6), 0.25 m march, 12 m cap, against Engine.solidAt() = sim.cell.contains()
definition.occluded_frac: fraction of 21 rays across the forward 60 deg (+/-30, 3 deg apart) whose first solid is closer than 3 m
definition.judged_on: sim.camera.yaw — what the player looks through. body and combat yaw recorded beside it.
